THE DIRECTIONS

You will talk to four people. Record what you would say to each one. You can record again as many times as you want. When all four are recorded, click Submit.

The first time you press record, your computer will ask to use your microphone. Click Allow.

NEARESTFARTHEST
THE SCENE

You read the news on the school TV show. It starts in ten minutes, and you cannot leave the desk. Your story is called Farther Than the Small Cloud. Its chart shows four galaxies and how far away they are. The chart still needs how fast each one moves away from us. Four people each have one speed.

THE HISTORY

This story begins with al-Sufi, a star watcher from Iran. In 964, he made a book about the stars. He wrote about a small cloud in the night sky. Today we know that cloud is a whole galaxy.
